title: Celine White Striped Long-Sleeve Shirt (CET1683096-A75)
sizing: Size 50 (L) for 183cm/75kg/96cm chest/46cm shoulders. Sizes 46-52 (S-XL). Combed cotton poplin with dropped shoulder. At 96cm chest and 46cm shoulders, size 50 should give ~60cm shoulder and adequate chest room.
notes: Combed cotton poplin with liquid ammonia treatment. Pointed collar with shaped interlining, precision buttonholes, resin buttons with hand-stitching reinforcement. 3D chest pocket with brand logo, dropped shoulder, double-needle cuff stitching. ~220g.
